title: Deion Sanders sends message to Diego Pavia: 'Stay strong and don't let up'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Deion Sanders sends message to Diego Pavia: 'Stay strong and don't let up'
sources.description: Deion Sanders is throwing out his support of Diego Pavia after the Vanderbilt QB went undrafted, and remains yet to be signed by an NFL team.
